topics.title: Wall Street Predicts 16% S&P Rally for 2026
topics.description: Wall Street analysts predict a fourth straight year of stock market gains, the longest winning streak in nearly two decades
topics.claim: Wall Street analysts unanimously predict the S&P 500 will rally to 7,800 points by end of 2026, driven by strong corporate earnings and AI investment
topics.researchQuery: What is the historical accuracy of Wall Street consensus predictions, and what evidence supports or contradicts the claim that AI investment will drive a 16% S&P 500 rally in 2026?

topics.title: DOGE Claims $160B in Savings, Analysis Shows $135B in Costs
topics.description: Elon Musk's DOGE claimed to save $160 billion but federal spending actually increased during its operation
topics.claim: DOGE claimed to cut $150-160 billion in government spending, but federal spending increased by $248 billion year-over-year while workforce was reduced by 270,000
topics.researchQuery: What are the actual verified savings from DOGE operations versus their claims, and what was the net fiscal impact including severance costs and program disruptions?

topics.title: Russia-Ukraine Trilateral Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
topics.description: New round of US-Russia-Ukraine peace talks postponed to February 4-5 with territory disputes remaining central
topics.claim: Russia is demanding Ukraine cede a fifth of the Donetsk region it still controls as a condition for peace negotiations
topics.researchQuery: What specific territorial demands has Russia made in the 2026 peace negotiations, and how do they compare to pre-war boundaries and current control lines?

topics.title: Amazon Layoffs Total 30,000 Corporate Workers
topics.description: Amazon plans to reduce corporate workforce by 16,000 following 14,000 cuts in October 2025
topics.claim: Amazon is cutting 30,000 corporate jobs (10% of corporate workforce) while 55% of companies cite AI as a primary driver of 2026 layoffs
topics.researchQuery: What evidence supports the claim that AI implementation is driving 2026 tech layoffs, and how do current layoff rates compare to previous tech downturns?

topics.title: Whistleblower: Israeli Military Used Google Gemini AI
topics.description: SEC complaint alleges Google breached ethics rules to help Israeli contractor apply AI to drone surveillance
topics.claim: Google breached its own AI ethics rules by allowing an Israeli military contractor to use Gemini AI for drone surveillance video analysis
topics.researchQuery: What are Google's stated AI ethics policies regarding military applications, and what evidence exists that they were violated in the Israeli contractor case?

topics.title: Mistaken Deportations Increasing Under Trump Administration
topics.description: Immigration lawyers report wrongful deportation cases are getting worse, not better, following landmark Abrego Garcia case
topics.claim: More than 170 U.S. citizens have been detained in immigration enforcement due to database errors, and wrongful deportations are increasing despite a landmark court case
topics.researchQuery: How many documented cases of U.S. citizens or protected individuals being wrongfully detained or deported exist in 2025-2026, and what systemic failures enabled them?

topics.title: Trump Tariffs Raise Average Rate to 17%, Highest Since 1930s
topics.description: U.S. average effective tariff rate increased from 2.4% to 16.8%, potentially rising to 21%
topics.claim: Trump tariffs represent the largest US tax increase as percent of GDP since 1993, costing households an average of $1,300 in 2026
topics.researchQuery: What is the verified economic impact of Trump tariffs on U.S. households, and how does the $1,300 per household estimate compare to actual consumer price data?

topics.title: 16 Drug Companies Raised Prices Despite Trump Deals
topics.description: All 16 pharmaceutical companies with Trump administration pricing deals still raised prices on other drugs in 2026
topics.claim: All 16 drug companies that made deals with the Trump administration raised prices on 872 brand-name drugs in January 2026, while the deals only apply to Medicaid patients
topics.researchQuery: What specific drugs were covered under Trump administration pricing deals, and how do 2026 price increases compare to years prior to the agreements?

topics.title: ICE Detention Population Reached Record High of 66,000
topics.description: Immigration detention rose 75% in 2025, with deportation ratio changing from 1:2 to 14:1
topics.claim: The Trump administration plans to denaturalize up to 200 U.S. citizens per month in 2026 while ICE detention has reached the highest level ever recorded
topics.researchQuery: What legal authority does the administration cite for the 200 per month denaturalization quota, and what due process protections exist for targeted individuals?

topics.title: Russian Casualties Near 1.2 Million Since Invasion
topics.description: Combined Russian and Ukrainian casualties could reach 2 million by spring 2026
topics.claim: Russia has suffered nearly 1.2 million casualties since February 2022, more losses than any major power in any war since World War II
topics.researchQuery: What are the verified casualty estimates for Russian forces in Ukraine from independent sources, and how do they compare to official Russian and Ukrainian claims?

topics.title: Ukraine to File First Climate Reparations Claim Against Russia
topics.description: Ukraine preparing historic climate reparations claim estimating $43 billion in environmental damages
topics.claim: Ukraine estimates the cost of 236.8 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent generated by the Russian invasion at $43 billion and will file the first climate reparations claim in history
topics.researchQuery: What methodology is Ukraine using to calculate the $43 billion climate reparations figure, and what legal precedent exists for climate-based war reparations?

topics.title: AI-Washing Securities Lawsuits Surge in 2026
topics.description: Companies face increasing litigation for misrepresenting AI capabilities and revenue projections
topics.claim: Companies are facing securities class actions for AI-washing - making false claims about AI-driven efficiencies, misrepresenting legacy technology as AI, and exaggerating AI integration
topics.researchQuery: What specific AI-washing cases have been filed in 2025-2026, and what claims about AI capabilities were alleged to be fraudulent?

topics.title: Supreme Court Evaluating Trump Tariff Authority Under IEEPA
topics.description: Court of Appeals ruled fentanyl and reciprocal tariffs exceed Presidential authority
topics.claim: The Federal Circuit Court affirmed that Trump's fentanyl and reciprocal tariffs exceed the President's authority under IEEPA, with a Supreme Court ruling expected in early 2026
topics.researchQuery: What are the key legal arguments in the Supreme Court IEEPA tariff case, and what happens to collected tariff revenues if the Court rules them unlawful?

topics.title: Meta Ends Third-Party Fact-Checking Program
topics.description: Meta discontinued outside fact-checker partnerships that operated since 2016
topics.claim: Meta's decision to end third-party fact-checking will increase misinformation spread, while studies show fact-check labels reduce engagement by 46% on reposts
topics.researchQuery: What impact did Meta's fact-checking program have on misinformation spread from 2016-2025, and what evidence exists about effectiveness of Community Notes alternatives?

topics.title: Global Tech Layoffs Near 25,000 in January 2026
topics.description: Over 100 companies planning job cuts with AI cited as primary driver
topics.claim: Tech sector eliminated 25,000 jobs in January 2026 alone, with 55% of hiring managers expecting layoffs and 44% citing AI as a top driver of workforce reductions
topics.researchQuery: What proportion of 2026 tech layoffs are directly attributable to AI automation versus cost-cutting, and what roles are most affected?
